whyOnekof.label: Why Onekof
whyOnekof.heading1: Foreign tools weren't built for you.
whyOnekof.subtitle: Jira doesn't know about Pagume. Asana doesn't speak Amharic. Trello can't track ETB. Onekof does all of this — and more.
whyOnekof.ethiopianCalendarDesc: Native 13-month calendar with holidays, Amharic month names, and sprint planning.
whyOnekof.fourLanguagesDesc: Amharic, Afaan Oromoo, Tigrinya, and English. Human-translated, not machine-generated.
whyOnekof.etbBudgetTrackingDesc: Track every Birr. Create budgets, approve expenses, and generate financial reports.
whyOnekof.aiDocProcessorDesc: Upload contracts & proposals. AI extracts deadlines, flags risks, links to tasks.
whyOnekof.customWorkflowsDesc: Automation builder for Ethiopian organizations — government, private, NGO, construction.
whyOnekof.enterpriseSecurityDesc: RBAC, 2FA, audit logs, session management, and SOC 2 ready infrastructure.

calendar.desc: The only project management tool with a true Ethiopian calendar. Plan sprints in Meskerem, set deadlines in Pagume, track holidays, and toggle Gregorian seamlessly.

language.desc: Every label, button, notification, and report is available in Amharic, Afaan Oromoo, Tigrinya, and English. Human-translated, not machine-generated.

features.kanbanDesc: Drag-and-drop task management with custom columns, WIP limits, and swimlanes.

testimonials.label: Testimonials
testimonials.quote1: We tried Jira, Trello, and Asana. None understood Ethiopian workflows. Onekof's calendar integration alone saved us hours every week.
testimonials.quote2: Finally, a PM tool our entire team can use — including those most comfortable in Amharic. The language support isn't an afterthought, it's core to the product.
testimonials.quote3: The budget tracking in ETB with approval workflows eliminated our spreadsheet chaos. Real-time visibility into every project's financial health.
testimonials.quote4: The AI document processor changed how we handle procurement. It extracts deadlines and flags risks from contracts automatically — saving us days of manual work.
testimonials.quote5: As a government ministry, we needed Ethiopian calendar support and Amharic interface. Onekof is the only tool that treats these as first-class features, not plugins.
testimonials.quote6: We onboarded 200+ team members in a week. The guided onboarding flow made it effortless — everyone was productive from day one, regardless of their language preference.
